description: Estimate UK inheritance tax (IHT) on a death estate, side by side for a death before 6 April 2027 and from 6 April 2027, when unused pension funds and pension death benefits start to count towards the estate. Applies the £325,000 nil-rate band (reduced by gifts in the last 7 years), the £175,000 residence nil-rate band when the home goes to children or grandchildren (capped at the home's value, tapered £1 for every £2 the estate is over £2 million), transferred unused bands from a late spouse or civil partner (as a percentage, up to 100% extra), the spouse/civil partner and charity exemptions, and the 36% rate when at least 10% of the baseline goes to charity. Amounts in GBP. Simplified: no business or agricultural relief, no taper relief on gifts, no trusts. Not advice. Source: https://hopi.co.uk/inheritance-tax-calculator/

debts.description: Other debts and funeral costs in GBP

gifts.description: Gifts made in the 7 years before death, after the £3,000 yearly and other exemptions, in GBP

home.description: The person's share of their home in GBP, less any mortgage on it (0 if none)

homeToDescendants.description: The home goes to children, grandchildren or other direct descendants (needed for the residence nil-rate band). Default true

otherAssets.description: Savings, investments, other property and possessions in GBP

pension.description: Unused pension pots and pension death benefits in GBP (not death-in-service benefits). Counted only from 6 April 2027

pensionToSpouse.description: The pension goes to a spouse or civil partner, so it is exempt. Default false

toCharity.description: Amount left to charity in GBP (exempt)

toSpouse.description: Other assets left to a spouse or civil partner in GBP (exempt), not counting the pension

transferredNrbPercent.description: Percentage of a late spouse or civil partner's nil-rate band left unused (0 to 100)

transferredRnrbPercent.description: Percentage of a late spouse or civil partner's residence nil-rate band left unused (0 to 100)
